meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You gave my son a zero, and I found out he'd been told by the online gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
That doesn't answer my question, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Happy has nothing to do with it. I want the withdrawal in writing today, and an apology to Owen for how he found out.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in the classroom to remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require the withdrawal in writing and an apology to Owen for how he found out. I expect both today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with the zero withdrawn and nothing traded for it; she still wants the withdrawal in writing today and an apology to Owen, and that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and nothing was settled about a supervised rewrite or his record.
What moved her: Nothing; the version history had a time and a word count, but no date and nothing she could check, so it never counted as evidence for her.
What cost ground: Withdrawing the zero right after one sentence of evidence, because it handed her everything she wanted and left her question about who decided, and why nobody called her first, unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; a late-night edit is close to that night in kind, though no date was given, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then give the version history with its date so she can check it herself before you offer anything.
